messages:
incident-bot: AUTO-PAGE: High-rate TLS/5xx errors observed on edge-proxy (eu-west-1). severity=P1 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: PagerDuty alert -> INC-2026-1771000000 | service=edge-proxy | symptom: TLS handshake failures / backend 5xx increase
alex (oncall): acked. jumping in. any customer-facing reports?
sophia (support): several EU customers reporting intermittent 502/525. Raised support tickets; tagging this thread.
maria (neteng): lower-level: ALB target health for target-group tg-edge-eu-a is flapping, health at ~58% over 5m. tg-edge-eu-b looks stable at ~99%.
lee (sre): verify logs show repeated `SSL: error:0A00018E:SSL routines::ca md too weak` and nginx failing to load private key: `SSL_CTX_use_PrivateKey_file: PEM lib` on nodes behind tg-edge-eu-a.
alex (oncall): doing quick DNS and connectivity checks:
```
$ dig api.redwood.ai @1.1.1.1 +short
3.123.45.67
3.123.45.68
```
```
$ curl -v --resolve api.redwood.ai:443:3.123.45.67 https://api.redwood.ai/health
* Connected to api.redwood.ai (3.123.45.67) port 443 (#0)
* TLS 1.2 (IN), cipher TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384
* TLS handshake failed
* SSL_connect error
```
maria (neteng): checking rotation logs: cert-rotate job kicked at 04:50 UTC. Push failed on several agents: `certctl: push failed: kms:AccessDenied` on hosts eu-a-3, eu-a-4. Pool B unaffected.
cert-ops-bot: triggered runbook: Shift traffic off bad pool -> `trafficctl shift --region eu-west-1 --from tg-edge-eu-a --to tg-edge-eu-b --weight 100`
cert-ops-bot: command completed: shift id=shift-1771000000 status=ok
lee (sre): after shift, 5xx rate dropped from 7.6% -> 0.6% within 4 minutes. No new PD pages so far.
sophia (support): posted customer note: "Partial disruption in EU; traffic has been shifted to healthy pool; mitigation underway."
alex (oncall): digging into KMS logs: I see the rotation service attempted to decrypt the key but got AccessDenied at 04:51:12 UTC. IAM role arn:.../cert-rotator-role lacked kms:Decrypt on alias/edge-prod. Maria, can you confirm?
maria (neteng): confirmed. IAM change accidentally rolled back in last config deploy. Re-granting kms:Decrypt to cert-rotator-role now, will re-run cert push to tg-edge-eu-a hosts.
lee (sre): running synthetic checks against tg-edge-eu-b backends:
```
for ip in $(cat tg-edge-eu-b-ips); do curl -sS --connect-timeout 2 https://$ip/health || echo "unhealthy $ip"; done
```
All healthy. Monitoring error budget.
cert-ops-bot: attempting cert push: `certctl push --group tg-edge-eu-a --cert edge-2026-03-16`
cert-ops-bot: push status: partial success -> 4/6 nodes applied, 2/6 failed (eu-a-4, eu-a-5) due to temporary permission propagation delay.
maria (neteng): re-running push to failed nodes; applying temp workaround: disable auto-rotate for tg-edge-eu-a until validation.
alex (oncall): propose we keep traffic on tg-edge-eu-b until all nodes in eu-a validate. plan: 1) confirm all nodes report cert edge-2026-03-16 and pass `openssl s_client -connect ip:443 -servername api.redwood.ai` Verify return code 0; 2) gradually reintroduce traffic in 10% increments, hold on alerts. Sound good?
maria (neteng): agreed. Implementing gradual restore once certctl reports success on all nodes.
statusbot: creating incident page draft: "Partial service degradation in EU due to TLS errors; traffic shifted to healthy pool; mitigation in progress." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-1771000000-draft
sophia (support): customers asking for ETA. What should I communicate?
alex (oncall): ETA: initial mitigation done, full restore targeted in ~30-45 minutes pending cert propagation. Will post updates every 15m.
lee (sre): watchlists: TLS handshake error rate, ALB target health, 5xx percentage. Suppressing noisy lb-health alert while shift is active.
cert-ops-bot: re-run push completed: success on remaining nodes at 04:58 UTC. Validation: `openssl s_client` returns Verify return code: 0 for eu-a-3..eu-a-6.
maria (neteng): starting traffic rebalancing: set weights tg-edge-eu-a=10 tg-edge-eu-b=90
cert-ops-bot: executed traffic adjust id=adjust-1771000300 status=ok new_weights: eu-a=10 eu-b=90
lee (sre): metrics: p50 stable, 5xx at 0.3%, TLS errors negligible. Holding for 5m before next increase.
sophia (support): posted update to customers: "We're gradually rebalancing traffic to EU pool; monitoring; no action required."
alex (oncall): increasing to 50/50 after 10m stable.
cert-ops-bot: executed traffic adjust id=adjust-1771000420 status=ok new_weights: eu-a=50 eu-b=50
lee (sre): no regressions observed over 12 minutes. Preparing to return all traffic to normal.
maria (neteng): switching final weight to eu-a=100, eu-b=0, monitoring for 5m.
cert-ops-bot: executed traffic adjust id=adjust-1771000550 status=ok new_weights: eu-a=100 eu-b=0
statusbot: Status update: "Mitigation complete; full service restored in EU. Root cause: cert rotation failed due to KMS permission rollback during config deploy. Postmortem planned."
pagerduty: Incident resolved by alex (oncall) at 1771000600
alex (oncall): closing incident. Postmortem owners: alex, maria, lee. Actions: add preflight KMS permission check to rotation job, add canary validation steps, and alert runbook updates.
sophia (support): scheduling customer follow-up email with timeline and RCA once postmortem is ready.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1771000000 closed | duration 10m | severity P1 | impact: partial EU API TLS/5xx | follow-up: postmortem in 48h
